recipe.title: Curried sausages
recipe.notes: This is a Chelsea Winter recipe.

i.n: chopped parsley or coriander, to serve

method.s: Pour a splash of oil into a large frying pan over a medium heat and brown the sausages (they don't need to be cooked through). Set aside and when cool enough to handle slice into 1cm pieces.
Add the butter or oil to the same pan over a medium heat and add onion and carrot. Cook, stirring for 10 minutes until the onion is sticky, soft and golden.
Stir in the apple, garlic and ginger and cook for another two minutes.
Add the spices and cook for another minute. Add a tablespoon of the coconut milk if it's looking a little dry.

Transfer the sausages back into the pan and combine with the coconut milk. stock, water, chutney and tomato paste. Leave to simmer over a medium to low heat for 30 - 40 minutes, stirring occasionally.
Add the frozen peas or spinach and cook for a further 5 minutes. Stir through the lemon juice and season with salt (you may need more than you think).
Garnish with parsley or coriander and serve on mash or rice with seasonal vegetables.
